title: Rename writeMsg to writeMessage across the source tree
text:
writeMsg is a bad name. Rename it to writeMessage everywhere it appears:
src/log.js (the definition and the export) and its three callers
src/a.js, src/b.js and src/c.js.

Behaviour must not change and no other API may change; after the rename
the string "writeMsg" must not appear in any of those four files.
